title: Make the fmt Lint live witness distinguish rustfmt output from formatter setup failure
outcome: The live negative formatting witness fails if rustfmt did not process the source, while continuing to prove storage and settlement of a genuine check-only formatting failure as Lint.
acceptance: The live witness discriminates actual rustfmt diff output for its deliberately unformatted source from missing rustfmt or toolchain/setup failures, using observable behavior without retries or timeout inflation.
The live witness still checks the unchanged source, failed fmt plus five unrun stages, stored Lint/failed verification and settlement without Test producers.
